title: Millennium Family TV Anime Casts Haruna Mikawa
content: The staff for the television anime of Sho Kasugai 's Millennium Family ( Odoru Sennen Kazoku ) manga announced on Tuesday that Haruna Mikawa voices Raine, the second daughter of the Benfield family.
author: ANN

title: Masaki Andō's Mojiponika! Manga Ends on November 25
content: Manga author Masaki Andō announced on Friday that his Mojiponika! manga will end in the next issue of Kodansha 's Afternoon magazine on November 25. The comedy manga centers on Tsumugu, the son of an embroidery shop owner.
author: ANN

title: 5 1990s Classic Anime That Are Impossible to Stream Anywhere
content: There’s no denying that the 1990s were a revolutionary era for the anime industry, but unfortunately, many of the classics couldn’t stand the test of time. The decade completely shifted the global market since several shows became popular in the West due to television broadcasts.
author: ComicBook

title: Yome ga Kuru Artist saku Launches New Kimi to Sakura no Hanataba wo Manga
content: Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket platform announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Saturday that Yome ga Kuru! (My Wife is Coming!) artist saku will launch a new series titled Kimi to Sakura no Hanataba wo (A Bouquet of Cherry Blossoms and You) on the platform on November 1. saku launched the Yome ga Kuru!
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Is Already a Huge Disappointment Before Its Biggest Battle
content: Dragon Ball Super : Beerus is already a huge disappointment in its Episode 3, and the main battle between Goku and Beerus hasn’t even begun. The anime returned this month as part of the Fall 2026 lineup, but instead of continuing the story with a sequel, Toei Animation released a remake version of the previous arcs.
author: ComicBook

title: Phantom Busters Anime Reveals First Teaser Visual, Main Staff and Cast
content: Phantom Busters anime has revealed the first teaser visual, along with introducing the main voice cast and staff. The anime was announced last month, and it is set to release in 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: Eito Chida Launches New Hoshibarai no Chidori Manga
content: The November issue of Square Enix 's Gangan Joker magazine announced last Thursday that Eito Chida will launch a new series titled Hoshibarai no Chidori in the next issue on November 20.
author: ANN

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss Gachiakuta
content: Gachiakuta ’s anime debut in Summer 2025 established it as one of the best new anime series of the year, as reflected in the several awards it won thanks to its unique approach.
author: ComicBook

title: Live-Action Sins of Kujo Film's New Trailer Unveils Theme Song
content: TOHO Movies presented a new trailer and poster visual for the live-action film of Shohei Manabe 's Kujō no Taizai (Sins of Kujo) manga on Wednesday. The trailer announces and previews the theme song "Dispel" by the band hitsujibungaku , who also performed the theme song for the previous live-action series.
author: ANN

title: We Are Aliens Film Wins Awards at Rome, Philadelphia Film Festivals
content: Kōhei Kadowaki and NOTHING NEW 's We Are Aliens ( Ware Ware wa Uchūjin ) anime film received Special Mentions in the Alice nelle città section of the 21st Rome Film Festival on Sunday. The film also won an Honorable Mention in the 35th Philadelphia Film Festival on Sunday.
author: ANN
